content.comment_body: Hello, I am currently working on a project where I need to select a model using a Weintek HMI. Based on this selection, a [product_name] will activate or deactivate its program. The control logic has been set up on both the [product_name] and the HMI. However, I am having trouble reading local bit values from the HMI into the [product_name]. If I use network IO, each [product_name] and individual network interface on the HMI must be configured separately. Is there a way to access Weintek HMI data from multiple [product_name] devices without configuring each one individually? In my setup, I have 37 [product_name] devices connected to a single HMI. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing integration issues between a Weintek HMI and a large number of [product_name] units. While the logic works on both sides, reading local bits from the HMI into all [product_name] units is problematic. Manual configuration for each device and the HMI's network interface is required, making scaling the solution inefficient and cumbersome.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking an efficient solution to read HMI local bits across multiple [product_name] units without the need for repeated manual configuration for every individual device and network interface.
